SCOPE_AS_QUALIFIER_RULES: Use inline qualifiers for simple single-statement context.
Do not allocate an ApplicabilityScope for every statement.
Inline qualifiers are ALL_OF. A shared scope preserves its own ALL_OF/ANY_OF; inline-only conditions are conjoined with the shared expression, never flattened.
Unknown context must be explicit and is never a wildcard.
SCOPE_AS_OBJECT_RULES: Admit an immutable identified scope when reused across statements/capabilities, or when independent governance/versioning requires identity.
scope_ref resolves to ApplicabilityScope; changes receive a new ID, preserving earlier revision meaning.
A shared scope is not a universal qualifier template: only dimensions allowed by the predicate may occur in the referenced scope.
qualifier_storage: StatementRevision.qualifiers or ApplicabilityScope.qualifiers use the same registered value shapes.
conflict_rule: Inline and referenced values for the same dimension must agree exactly; otherwise reject. Never choose a silent precedence or widen scope.
explicit_rule: explicit requires nonempty inline or referenced context; not_applicable forbids context; partially_known requires at least one known dimension; unknown carries no known dimensions.
temporal_scope: Validity intervals and fully governed scope revision lineages are deferred; versions use subject-bound version_constraint values.

activation_policy.specified: Nonempty when; every condition is required (ALL_OF); strength is unchanged.
activation_policy.unconditional: Explicit absence of additional activation condition: when may be empty/absent; other statement applicability still applies.
activation_policy.unknown: when must be empty/absent; condition information unavailable; never interpreted as universal.
activation_policy.optional_when: OPTIONAL + specified when is allowed as conditional admissibility/advice only; it does not become REQUIRED.

shared_scope_contract.known_status_rule: explicit requires known context; partially_known requires known dimensions and a nonempty disjoint unknown_dimensions list. unknown requires empty qualifiers. not_applicable requires empty qualifiers. Unknown is not a wildcard.
shared_scope_contract.duplicate_rule: Equal same-dimension inline/shared values are deduplicated as shared members, preserving the shared combination. Conflicts reject/REVIEW_REQUIRED even for ANY_OF.
shared_scope_contract.composition: (shared expression with its original combination) AND (inline dimensions absent from shared); never flatten an ANY_OF group into an ALL_OF map.
shared_scope_contract.evaluation: ALL_OF: false if any false, true if all true, otherwise unknown. ANY_OF: true if any true, false if all false, otherwise unknown. scope_status=unknown returns unknown; partially_known contributes an unknown branch. Empty not_applicable is a neutral context, not proof of applicability.
shared_scope_contract.immutability: Existing scope ID cannot be reused with changed status/combination/context/unknown dimensions; use new ID.
